what: When the line drawing (SVG) reaches 25% below screen center, each group draws at the same time, lines within a group are drawn .2s apart over 1.5s, and fill areas (like a black book spine) go from transparent to dark over the same 1.5s. Once only

options.dur: Time to draw one line (s), default 1.5
options.each: Delay between lines in a group (s), default .2
options.trigger: With this css, the nearest ancestor is the trigger (the original uses the whole .home-books section) — if none, the image itself
options.[data-fx-part=group]: Group of lines drawn together (g) — if omitted, the whole drawing is one group
options.[data-fx-part=fill]: Fill (rect etc.) that darkens while the line is being drawn

use: <svg data-fx="stroke-draw-in" viewBox="0 0 800 300"><g data-fx-part="group"><path d="…" fill="none"/></g><rect data-fx-part="fill" …/></svg>

from.where: index.html .cm-books__illust (two line drawings of book stacks, five per bundle)
